component.name: SDDM Variant Manager
component.summary: Browse, preview, and install SDDM login themes without logging out

description.p: SDDM Variant Manager is for anyone who uses SDDM — Hyprland, Plasma, or another desktop — and wants to rice the login screen without logging out every time to test a theme.

It lists all installed SDDM themes, supports multi-variant collections in a Themes/ folder, installs themes from local files/folders or (experimentally) from a public GitHub repository without executing install.sh, and runs the real greeter in test mode so video and animated backgrounds preview faithfully (unlike static thumbnails in KDE settings alone).

Install or remove themes from local archives or folders, preview backgrounds, apply variants, and test the full SDDM greeter with sddm-greeter or sddm-greeter-qt6. The app warns when a theme’s Qt5/Qt6 stack does not match the system greeter. Close the full preview with Alt+Tab and the in-app Close preview button.
Experimental GitHub theme install: clone a public repo, read install.sh without running it, and copy themes into this distro’s SDDM directories.
Master–detail dashboard: theme library, large preview, and a horizontal variant filmstrip. Product colors override desktop theme chrome. Light and dark palettes.
